_meta.description: Curated Environment-tab metadata. Curated entries override optional locally discovered entries by name. The UI treats environment edits as restart-required; discovery is not automatic.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
curated.summary: Base URL for the messages API.
curated.detail: Use a compatible gateway endpoint. This setting also affects provider detection; it does not redirect every background service.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
curated.summary: Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer <value>.
curated.detail: Primary auth for gateway/proxy setups. Prefer putting this in managed-settings so it cannot be overridden; in user settings.json it is overridable by shell env.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
curated.summary: API key sent as x-api-key header.
curated.detail: Used by first-party Anthropic auth and some gateways expecting the api-key format. Mutually exclusive with ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in most flows.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
curated.summary: Model slug for the Opus slot.
curated.detail: Append [1m] for a per-model 1M context window (stock mechanism, stripped on the wire).

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME
curated.summary: Display name for the Opus slot in /model.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
curated.summary: Picker description for the Opus slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
curated.summary: Capabilities advertised for the Opus slot (e.g. thinking,interleaved_thinking).

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
curated.summary: Model slug for the Sonnet slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME
curated.summary: Display name for the Sonnet slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
curated.summary: Picker description for the Sonnet slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
curated.summary: Capabilities advertised for the Sonnet slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
curated.summary: Model slug for the Haiku slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME
curated.summary: Display name for the Haiku slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
curated.summary: Picker description for the Haiku slot.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
curated.summary: Model slug for the Fable slot.
curated.detail: Also affects Fable availability. Prefer this configuration path over a separate availability patch when supported by your upstream version.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION
curated.summary: Adds an extra entry to the /model picker.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_NAME
curated.summary: Display name for the custom model entry.

curated.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_DESCRIPTION
curated.summary: Picker description for the custom model entry.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
curated.summary: Populate /model from the gateway's /v1/models endpoint.
curated.detail: Combined with the gateway_models_unfilter mod to show all models unfiltered.

curated.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG
curated.summary: Event-level stream watchdog — aborts stalled connections.
curated.detail: Off by default; effectively required for third-party providers. Detects stalls at the parsed-event level.

curated.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG
curated.summary: Byte-level stream watchdog.
curated.detail: Default is Anthropic-API-only; proxy connections don't get it. Catches TCP stalls the event watchdog misses.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING
curated.summary: Stream large tool inputs (Write/Edit) progressively.
curated.detail: Off by default for gateway connections; without it, large tool inputs appear to hang until fully generated.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK
curated.summary: Keep the non-streaming fallback path enabled when 0.
curated.detail: The fallback bridges the streaming loop to the SDK retry layer. Disabling (1) trades hangs for zero recovery from transient errors.

curated.name: ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H
curated.summary: Extend prompt cache TTL 5min -> 1hr (Anthropic-only).
curated.detail: Higher write cost but amortizes with heavy agent usage. Ignored by non-Anthropic providers.

curated.name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
curated.summary: Per-request timeout (ms).
curated.detail: Non-streaming fallback inherits this; a dead connection hangs for the full timeout. Watchdogs handle slow-but-alive streams, so keep this modest.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES
curated.summary: Max retries per request.
curated.detail: High retry counts combined with long timeouts can delay failure substantially. Actual duration also depends on backoff and the retry policy.

curated.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
curated.summary: Opt out of all telemetry.

curated.name: DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING
curated.summary: Opt out of Sentry error reporting.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY
curated.summary: Disable quality surveys.

curated.name: DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS
curated.summary: Suppress cost warnings.

curated.name: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER
curated.summary: Block CLI self-update.
curated.detail: Protects a patched version installed via claude-mod.

curated.name: FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS
curated.summary: Keep plugin auto-updates working when DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1.
curated.detail: Plugins don't touch the CLI binary.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
curated.summary: Disable nonessential network traffic (40+ gates).
curated.detail: Any string value (even "0") triggers the disable via the raw if(process.env.VAR) check. Note: this also disables in-CLI GitHub PR CI status display.

curated.name: ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS
curated.summary: Enable claude.ai MCP servers.
curated.detail: Disable when managing MCP servers yourself.

curated.name: DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK
curated.summary: Skip the GrowthBook feature-flag fetch.
curated.detail: Saves startup latency when the flag endpoint times out (e.g. third-party providers). Flags default to false.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER
curated.summary: Enable fullscreen TUI rendering.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE
curated.summary: Hide or disable fast mode.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
curated.summary: Must be 0 to honor the [1m] suffix on a model id.
curated.detail: When 1, the per-model 1M context suffix is ignored.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION
curated.summary: Grayed-out prompt predictions after responses.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT
curated.summary: Interactive /init flow (asks which files to generate).

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
curated.summary: Force auto-memory on (0) or off (1); documents intent.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
curated.summary: Global cap on output tokens.
curated.detail: Raising past 32000 can over-request some model slots when the bundle treats models identically.

curated.name: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
curated.summary: Deferred MCP tool loading for large toolsets.

curated.name: DISABLE_INSTALLATION_CHECKS
curated.summary: Skip installation checks.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_SANDBOX_SHOW_INDICATOR
curated.summary: Show 'SandboxedBash' vs 'Bash' in the UI.
curated.detail: Diagnostic for when/if the sandbox is active.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY
curated.summary: Force on the session recap (40-word summary after 5+ min idle).
curated.detail: The GrowthBook flag for this returns false on third-party providers; this env override is needed. Costs one extra API call per return-from-idle.

curated.name: DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide /upgrade.

curated.name: DISABLE_LOGIN_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide /login (auth via token, not Claude.ai login).

curated.name: DISABLE_LOGOUT_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide /logout.

curated.name: DISABLE_INSTALL_GITHUB_APP_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide the GitHub App install command.

curated.name: DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide /extra-usage (managed provider-side).

curated.name: DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND
curated.summary: Hide /feedback.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
curated.summary: Forked subagents inherit full conversation context.
curated.detail: Consider input-token costs before enabling full-context inheritance.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS
curated.summary: Multi-agent coordination with shared task lists.

curated.name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
curated.summary: Auto-background long-running agent tasks after ~2min.

curated.name: BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
curated.summary: Default Bash timeout (ms).

curated.name: BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
curated.summary: Max Bash timeout cap (ms). Background commands also respect this.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY
curated.summary: Max parallel tool executions.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
curated.summary: Max tokens per file read.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_INSTR_DELTA
curated.summary: Delta MCP tool instructions.

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS
curated.summary: TTL for the API-key helper cache (ms).

curated.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
curated.summary: Drop the built-in git workflow instructions.

rules.title: Enable stream watchdogs for non-Anthropic providers
rules.when: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set and host is not api.anthropic.com
rules.rationale: Proxy/gateway connections don't get the byte watchdog by default; stalled streams hang without these.

rules.title: Retry x timeout hang budget is large
rules.rationale: High retry counts and long timeouts can delay final failure. Check the selected retry policy as well as the per-request timeout.

rules.title: Auth token in user settings.json is overridable
rules.when: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set in user settings.json and not in managed
rules.rationale: Shell env or --settings can override a user-settings token. Move it to managed-settings (deploy-time) for an non-overridable floor.
